title: Specify authorization
acceptance: Defines operator authorization flows and the multi-scope pre-authorization envelope: scopes, expiry, quotas, level cap, runtime and version binding.
Lists the actions that always require a fresh strong confirmation and states that a failed validation gate can never be overridden.

Defines the anomaly-level scale (Normal, Elevated, High), who decides it, and the conditions under which a session may continue while the console is unreachable (automatic assistance, a covering pre-authorization, and the level the operator allows).
Resolves CNS-O-05 and CNS-O-06, or records deferrals permitted by D-10.
